offering_description.value: Provides electronic payment processing and payment software to lenders, loan servicers, debt collection agencies, and businesses. It integrates with customers’ existing software to collect payments, disburse funds, and automate supplier payments.

primary_products.value: Payment processing software; online payment portals; accounts payable automation software; payment integration APIs

primary_services.value: Card and ACH payment processing; electronic disbursements; supplier payment processing

customer_segment.value: B2B: Consumer lenders, loan servicers, debt collection agencies, credit unions, and businesses with accounts payable teams

end_markets.value: Consumer lending; debt collection; credit unions; mortgage servicing; business accounts payable

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: Fees for processing incoming payments and outgoing disbursements

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Routes card and bank payment instructions for lenders, servicers, and businesses; software / platform: Integrates payment workflows into lending, servicing, and accounting systems

specialization.value: related lines: Consumer payment acceptance, electronic disbursements, and supplier payment automation

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales teams serving lenders, servicers, and business accounts; partners / resellers: Loan management and accounting software providers that embed payment tools

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Card network rules, PCI DSS, and Nacha operating rules for electronic payments

notes: Current coverage outside the United States is uncertain.
